name: 32955 · Rockledge, FL
findings: ZIP 32955 (Rockledge) has 154 nonprofit organizations. 62 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 50 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32955 (Rockledge) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
